NIELIT CCC Online Form, Admit Card, Result 2026 – Full Details

National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT) conducts the Course on Computer Concepts (CCC) Examination 2026 every month, for which the CCC Online Form, Admit Card, and Result are released from time to time. NIELIT CCC Online Registration Form 2026 has started Till the Date 30 September 2026. Candidates who wish to apply for NIELIT CCC Admission 2026 are advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying and check all important details such as Eligibility, Application Fee, Age Limit, Exam Pattern, and other requirements. All important information related to the NIELIT CCC Online Form 2026, Notification, Admit Card, Result, and Apply Online Link is provided below.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date : January 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date : December 2026
  • Exam Date : Every Month
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Admit Card : After 1 Month Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC Candidates : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST Candidates : Rs. 500/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is NIELIT CCC Online Form, Admit Card, Result 2026?

NIELIT CCC Online Form, Admit Card, Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
